name: Microsoft Sentinel — hunting playbook
description: Identity and cloud focused hunts over a Sentinel workspace: Entra ID sign-ins, audit events, Office activity and Azure resource changes.

templates.name: Failed sign-ins grouped by source IP
templates.description: Starting point for any password attack triage.
templates.body:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago({{var:range}})
| where ResultType != "0"
| summarize Failures = count(), Accounts = dcount(UserPrincipalName),
            Targets = make_set(UserPrincipalName, 25),
            Reasons = make_set(ResultDescription, 5),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
          by IPAddress, Country = tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion)
| where Failures > 10
| sort by Accounts desc, Failures desc

templates.name: Password spray — many accounts, few attempts each
templates.description: Spraying looks different from brute force: a wide account fan-out with a low per-account count.
templates.body:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago({{var:range}})
| where ResultType in ("50126", "50053", "50055", "50056")
| summarize Attempts = count(), Accounts = dcount(UserPrincipalName) by IPAddress, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where Accounts >= 10 and Attempts / Accounts <= 5
| sort by Accounts desc

templates.name: Successful sign-in from a spraying source
templates.description: Joins the failures with the successes so you immediately see which account fell.
templates.body:
let sprayers = SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago({{var:range}})
    | where ResultType != "0"
    | summarize Failures = count(), Accounts = dcount(UserPrincipalName) by IPAddress
    | where Failures >= 20 and Accounts >= 5
    | project IPAddress;
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago({{var:range}})
| where ResultType == "0"
| where IPAddress in (sprayers)
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, AppDisplayName,
          Country = tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion), UserAgent, ConditionalAccessStatus
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

templates.name: Accounts signing in from several countries
templates.description: Cheap impossible-travel proxy that needs no ML: same account, several countries in the window.
templates.body:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago({{var:range}})
| where ResultType == "0"
| extend Country = tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion)
| summarize Countries = dcount(Country), CountryList = make_set(Country, 10),
            IPs = make_set(IPAddress, 10), Logons = count()
          by UserPrincipalName
| where Countries > 1
| sort by Countries desc

templates.name: Successful sign-ins over legacy authentication
templates.description: Legacy protocols bypass conditional access and MFA; a success here is worth a look.
templates.body:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago({{var:range}})
| where ResultType == "0"
| where ClientAppUsed in ("Other clients", "IMAP4", "POP3", "SMTP", "Exchange ActiveSync", "Authenticated SMTP")
| summarize Logons = count(), IPs = make_set(IPAddress, 10), Apps = make_set(ClientAppUsed, 5)
          by UserPrincipalName
| sort by Logons desc

templates.name: Privileged roles assigned
templates.description: Directory role changes, which is how an attacker makes access durable.
templates.body:
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago({{var:range}})
| where OperationName has_any ("Add member to role", "Add eligible member to role")
| extend Actor = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName),
         Target = tostring(TargetResources[0].userPrincipalName),
         Role = tostring(TargetResources[0].modifiedProperties[1].newValue)
| project TimeGenerated, OperationName, Actor, Target, Role, Result
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

templates.name: OAuth application consent granted
templates.description: Illicit consent grants survive a password reset, so they are worth reviewing individually.
templates.body:
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago({{var:range}})
| where OperationName has_any ("Consent to application", "Add delegated permission grant", "Add app role assignment")
| extend Actor = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName),
         App = tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName),
         Permissions = tostring(TargetResources[0].modifiedProperties)
| project TimeGenerated, OperationName, Actor, App, Permissions, Result
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

templates.name: Inbox forwarding or redirect rules created
templates.description: The single most reliable business email compromise signal.
templates.body:
OfficeActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago({{var:range}})
| where Operation in~ ("New-InboxRule", "Set-InboxRule", "UpdateInboxRules", "Set-Mailbox")
| where tostring(Parameters) has_any ("ForwardTo", "RedirectTo", "ForwardAsAttachmentTo", "ForwardingSmtpAddress", "DeleteMessage")
| project TimeGenerated, UserId, Operation, ClientIP, Parameters
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

templates.name: Mailbox delegation granted
templates.description: Full access or send-as granted to another account, a quiet way to keep reading someone's mail.
templates.body:
OfficeActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago({{var:range}})
| where Operation in~ ("Add-MailboxPermission", "Add-RecipientPermission", "AddFolderPermissions")
| project TimeGenerated, UserId, Operation, ClientIP, OfficeObjectId, Parameters
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

templates.name: Network security group rules changed
templates.description: Firewall openings in the cloud subscription, including who made them.
templates.body:
AzureActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago({{var:range}})
| where OperationNameValue has_any ("NETWORKSECURITYGROUPS/SECURITYRULES/WRITE", "NETWORKSECURITYGROUPS/WRITE", "NETWORKSECURITYGROUPS/SECURITYRULES/DELETE")
| project TimeGenerated, Caller, CallerIpAddress, OperationNameValue, ResourceGroup, Resource, ActivityStatusValue
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

templates.name: Key Vault secrets read
templates.description: Secret retrieval by an unusual principal is a strong post-compromise signal.
templates.body:
AzureDiagnostics
| where TimeGenerated > ago({{var:range}})
| where ResourceType == "VAULTS" and OperationName in ("SecretGet", "KeyGet", "CertificateGet")
| summarize Reads = count(), Secrets = dcount(id_s), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
          by identity_claim_upn_s, CallerIPAddress, Resource
| sort by Reads desc

templates.name: Log sources that stopped reporting
templates.description: A blind spot is not a hunt result, but it is the reason a hunt found nothing.
templates.body:
union withsource = TableName *
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| summarize LastEvent = max(TimeGenerated), Events = count() by TableName
| extend HoursSilent = datetime_diff("hour", now(), LastEvent)
| where HoursSilent > 6
| sort by HoursSilent desc
